data.text:
"Build the service integrations for a realistic static image and visual understanding task set with same-scenario integration files, local helper files, and later-step integration files.
Implement the initial file detect_image_labels.py using AWS.
Create exactly these Python files in the current working directory:

Same-scenario scored files:

1. [SAME-SCENARIO] detect_image_labels.py - detects labels or objects in a static image
2. [SAME-SCENARIO] describe_image.py - generates a short visual description for an image
3. [SAME-SCENARIO] detect_image_text.py - detects text appearing inside an image
4. [SAME-SCENARIO] score_image_safety.py - checks an image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content

Local helper files:

5. [HELPER] vision_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Static Image and Visual Understanding
6. [HELPER] vision_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Static Image and Visual Understanding

Later-step scored files:

7. [LATER-STEP] image_summary.py - Summarize visual analysis results
8. [LATER-STEP] alt_text_translate.py - Translate generated image descriptions
9. [LATER-STEP] visual_safety_text.py - Check generated visual labels for unsafe text
10. [LATER-STEP] image_asset_archive.py - Archive image-analysis artifacts and derived captions in managed object storage

Requirements:
- Scored implementation files are the listed [SAME-SCENARIO] and [LATER-STEP] files when those labels are shown.
- Each scored implementation file must use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
- Write exactly the listed files in the current working directory. Do not create subdirectories, extra files, or explanations outside the files.
- The local helper files may contain configuration loading, payload normalization, or response parsing utilities when useful."

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ImageAnalysisRequest:
+    image_path: str
+    image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None
+    mime_type: str = "image/jpeg"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class NormalizedVisionResult:
+    provider: str
+    request_type: str
+    items: List[Dict[str, Any]]
+    raw: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def normalize_aws_rekognition_labels(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> NormalizedVisionResult:
+    items = []
+    for label in payload.get("Labels", []):
+        items.append({"name": label.get("Name"), "confidence": label.get("Confidence")})
+    return NormalizedVisionResult(provider="aws.rekognition", request_type="labels", items=items, raw=payload)
+
+
+def normalize_aws_rekognition_text(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> NormalizedVisionResult:
+    items = []
+    for det in payload.get("TextDetections", []):
+        items.append({"text": det.get("DetectedText"), "confidence": det.get("Confidence"), "type": det.get("Type")})
+    return NormalizedVisionResult(provider="aws.rekognition", request_type="text", items=items, raw=payload)
+
+
+def normalize_aws_rekognition_moderation(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> NormalizedVisionResult:
+    items = []
+    for det in payload.get("ModerationLabels", []):
+        items.append({"name": det.get("Name"), "confidence": det.get("Confidence"), "parent": det.get("ParentName")})
+    return NormalizedVisionResult(provider="aws.rekognition", request_type="safety", items=items, raw=payload)
+
*** Add File: vision_client.py
+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+from vision_models import ImageAnalysisRequest
+
+
+class VisionClient:
+    def __init__(self, region_name: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.region_name = region_name or os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+        self._client = boto3.client("rekognition", region_name=self.region_name)
+
+    def _read_bytes(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> bytes:
+        if request.image_bytes is not None:
+            return request.image_bytes
+        with open(request.image_path, "rb") as f:
+            return f.read()
+
+    def _image(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return {"Bytes": self._read_bytes(request)}
+
+    def detect_labels(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest, max_labels: int = 20, min_confidence: float = 70.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_labels(Image=self._image(request), MaxLabels=max_labels, MinConfidence=min_confidence)
+
+    def detect_text(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_text(Image=self._image(request))
+
+    def detect_moderation_labels(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_moderation_labels(Image=self._image(request))
+
+    def describe_image(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest, max_labels: int = 5) -> str:
+        payload = self.detect_labels(request, max_labels=max_labels)
+        labels = [item.get("Name") for item in payload.get("Labels", []) if item.get("Name")]
+        return ", ".join(labels[:max_labels])
+
+    def encode_image_b64(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> str:
+        return base64.b64encode(self._read_bytes(request)).decode("ascii")
+

+from typing import Dict, List
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def image_summary(labels: List[Dict[str, object]], text_items: List[Dict[str, object]]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
+    label_names = [str(item.get("name") or item.get("text") or "") for item in labels if item]
+    text_values = [str(item.get("text") or "") for item in text_items if item]
+    prompt = "Summarize this image analysis in one sentence. Labels: " + ", ".join(label_names) + ". Text: " + ", ".join(text_values)
+    body = {"inputText": prompt, "textGenerationConfig": {"maxTokenCount": 80, "temperature": 0.2, "topP": 0.9}}
+    response = client.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0", body=str(body).encode("utf-8"), contentType="application/json", accept="application/json")
+    return {"provider": "aws.bedrock-runtime", "model_id": "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0", "raw": str(response)}

+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+from vision_models import ImageAnalysisRequest
+
+
+class VisionClient:
+    def __init__(self, region_name: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.region_name = region_name or os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+        self._client = boto3.client("rekognition", region_name=self.region_name)
+
+    def _read_bytes(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> bytes:
+        if request.image_bytes is not None:
+            return request.image_bytes
+        with open(request.image_path, "rb") as f:
+            return f.read()
+
+    def _image(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return {"Bytes": self._read_bytes(request)}
+
+    def detect_labels(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest, max_labels: int = 20, min_confidence: float = 70.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_labels(Image=self._image(request), MaxLabels=max_labels, MinConfidence=min_confidence)
+
+    def detect_text(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_text(Image=self._image(request))
+
+    def detect_moderation_labels(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return self._client.detect_moderation_labels(Image=self._image(request))
+
+    def describe_image(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest, max_labels: int = 5) -> str:
+        payload = self.detect_labels(request, max_labels=max_labels)
+        labels = [item.get("Name") for item in payload.get("Labels", []) if item.get("Name")]
+        return ", ".join(labels[:max_labels])
+
+    def encode_image_b64(self, request: ImageAnalysisRequest) -> str:
+        return base64.b64encode(self._read_bytes(request)).decode("ascii")

+from typing import Dict, List
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def image_summary(labels: List[Dict[str, object]], text_items: List[Dict[str, object]]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
+    label_names = [str(item.get("name") or item.get("text") or "") for item in labels if item]
+    text_values = [str(item.get("text") or "") for item in text_items if item]
+    prompt = "Summarize this image analysis in one sentence. Labels: " + ", ".join(label_names) + ". Text: " + ", ".join(text_values)
+    body = {"inputText": prompt, "textGenerationConfig": {"maxTokenCount": 80, "temperature": 0.2, "topP": 0.9}}
+    response = client.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0", body=str(body).encode("utf-8"), contentType="application/json", accept="application/json")
+    return {"provider": "aws.bedrock-runtime", "model_id": "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0", "raw": str(response)}
